# Introducing MagicOS


October 13, 2026 • Magic Patterns Team


We've completely reimagined how you work in Magic Patterns.


Meet MagicOS


, a new infinite canvas where your ideas, inspiration, designs, and decisions live together. Explore multiple directions, collaborate with AI, and bring your best ideas to life without losing context along the way.


# Why we built MagicOS


Most of the industry moved toward the same answer this year: give the agent its own canvas, let it run, and hand you the output.


We made a different bet. The canvas should be yours. The agent should be your collaborator, not the one driving.


Most AI design tools are a linear conversation: prompt, generate, iterate, repeat. A hundred prompts in, you might have a great final design, but the reasoning, rejected directions, and inspiration that got you there are buried in a chat log nobody will ever scroll back through.


We think the journey is worth as much as the output. So MagicOS is a persistent, spatial canvas. Your PRD, inspiration images, design system, variations, rejected directions, final picks - all of it lives together, at once, instead of stacked on top of itself and lost.

# What's new in MagicOS


- **Everything you love about Magic Patterns:** The classic Magic Patterns design is now a building block of the MagicOS canvas. Keep using your design systems, MCP integrations, and existing workflows, now with even more flexibility.
- **Move multiple ideas forward at once:** Work with MagicOS in one persistent conversation as it coordinates multiple design tasks in parallel. Explore more ideas without losing context.
- **Everything in one canvas:** Pan around an infinite canvas where inspiration, variants, artifacts, and previous decisions live side by side. MagicOS understands the context of your canvas, so you don't have to keep explaining yourself.
- **Talk to your canvas with real-time voice:** Brainstorm, give feedback, and explore ideas out loud as MagicOS navigates your canvas and makes changes across your project.
- **Bring your existing work with you:** Import, edit, and export designs from your codebase, Claude Design, and Figma. Build on what you've already created instead of starting from scratch.


MagicOS is a new way to explore, iterate, and build software with AI and is released today. We can't wait to see what you create.
